plugins.name: gruvbox
plugins.description: Gruvbox dark and light for Claude Code: native themes plus a copy of the skins mod painted in Gruvbox.

plugins.name: agents-panel
plugins.description: A pane with running and finished subagents: type, model, task and duration.

plugins.name: browser-pane
plugins.description: Opens the Homebrew terminal-browser beside the chat.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time. From anthropics/claude-code-playground (Apache-2.0).

plugins.name: usage-panel
plugins.description: A pane with context, 5-hour and weekly usage, what is left, and when each limit resets.

plugins.name: nvim-live
plugins.description: When Claude Code runs inside Neovim, plays each edit live there: opens the file and types the change in.
